neighbours.label: unclear shared context; best guess: predicates of something actually under way or embodied: 'X in action', 'is experiencing a kind of …', 'entered a world where …'
fire: The town meeting was a rare glimpse of local government in action.
Visitors can watch the old printing press in action every Sunday.
The rescue drill showed the new lifeboat crew in action.
The listener is experiencing a kind of stillness that words cannot hold.
The patient is experiencing a sort of calm he has not felt for years.
When the lights dimmed, we had entered a world where time stood still.
Crossing the border, they entered a world where nobody knew their names.
The video shows the robotic arm in action on the factory floor.
quiet: The town meeting ended when the council took legal action against the builder.
Visitors can buy the old printing press posters every Sunday.
The rescue drill was cancelled in favor of a classroom session.
The listener is buying a set of records that he cannot afford.
The patient is waiting for a nurse he has not met before.
When the lights dimmed, we had finished a meal of bread and soup.
Crossing the border, they bought a map that showed the mountain roads.
The video shows the robotic arm stored in a crate on the factory floor.
